content:
The anonymous question box is the most-used feature on NEXTGEN — and the least talked about.

The top three themes: scholarships nobody explains, career paths nobody maps, and mental health questions nobody asks out loud. Every question gets read by a human. Most get answered within 48 hours.
excerpt: Our question box answered 700+ doubts last term. Here's what students actually wanted to know.
title: The quiet power of asking (even anonymously)

content:
Pass 1: title, abstract, figures. Pass 2: introduction and conclusion. Pass 3: skim methods. Pass 4: read fully with notes. Pass 5: explain it to a friend.

If you can't explain it simply, you haven't read it yet.
excerpt: A five-pass method for reading academic papers, tuned for busy students.
title: Research corner: how to read a paper without drowning

content:
It started with a simple frustration: brilliant students kept reinventing the same wheels — hunting for workshops, waiting for announcements, losing opportunities in screenshot threads.

So we built one place for all of it. Forty students across design, writing and code shipped the first version in a single semester. This platform is the result — and it belongs to you.
excerpt: From a WhatsApp group to a working platform — the story of NEXTGEN's first build sprint.
title: How 40 students built this platform in one semester
